# Fig. S1. Sex effects on region-level connectivity are spatially correlated across datasets.
```{r load files}
# load parcel labels
schaefer200x17.labels <- read.csv(file.path(root, "atlases", "parcellations", "schaefer200x17_regionlist_final.csv"))
schaefer200x17.labels <- schaefer200x17.labels$label
  
# load network-pair labels
schaefer200x17.networkpair.labels <- read.csv(file.path(root, "atlases", "parcellations", "schaefer200x17_netpair_labels_noduplicates.csv"))
```

```{r spin test for supp fig 1, cache = TRUE}
datasets4 <- c(PNC = "PNC", NKI = "NKI", `HCP-D` = "HCPD", HBN = "HBN")
sexeffect_corrs <- lapply(c(FC_strength = "FC_strength", BNC = "BNC", WNC = "WNC"), make_sexeffect_corr)

# print r and p_spin  
lapply(sexeffect_corrs, function(x) list(r = round(x$corr, 2), p_spin = signif(x$p.mat, 2)))
```
  
```{r plot supp fig 1, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3}
corr_FC  <- plot_sexeffect_corr(sexeffect_corrs$FC_strength)
corr_BNC <- plot_sexeffect_corr(sexeffect_corrs$BNC)
corr_WNC <- plot_sexeffect_corr(sexeffect_corrs$WNC)
corr_legend <- get_legend(plot_sexeffect_corr(sexeffect_corrs$FC_strength, show_legend = TRUE))

header_row <- plot_grid(NULL,
                        panel_header("A", "Functional Connectivity\nStrength"),
                        panel_header("B", "Between-Network\nConnectivity"),
                        panel_header("C", "Within-Network\nConnectivity"),
                        NULL, ncol = 5, rel_widths = c(0.03, 1, 1, 1, 0.03))

matrix_row <- plot_grid(NULL, corr_FC, corr_BNC, corr_WNC, NULL,
                        ncol = 5, rel_widths = c(0.03, 1, 1, 1, 0.03))

corr_plots_final <- plot_grid(header_row, matrix_row, NULL, corr_legend, NULL,
                              nrow = 5, rel_heights = c(0.2, 1, 0.05, 0.3, 0.01))
corr_plots_final
```

# Fig. S2. Neurosynth-based contextualization of replicable sex differences in between- and within-network connectivity

Which Neurosynth terms show significant functional activation (z \> 1.64) within the parcels where females have higher WNC? What about where males have higher BNC?

```{r load neurosynth}
# code adapted from Val Sydnor's https://github.com/PennLINC/thalamocortical_development/blob/main/results/developmental_effects/thalamocortical_connectivity_development.Rmd
#Neurosynth z-score maps generated by nimare. Nimare uses multilevel kernel density analysis- Chi-square analysis + FDR-correction to use the same procedure as Neurosynth
neurosynth.terms <- read.csv(file.path(root, "covariate_analyses", "sex_diff", "input", "neurosynth_annotations", "schaefer200", "schaefer200x17_neurosynth_125terms.csv")) %>% select(-regionID) %>% rename(region = label)
neurosynth.termlist <- names(neurosynth.terms)[-1] #list of terms  
```

We examined the 10 most negatively correlated Neurosynth terms with the BNC sex difference map, focusing on negative correlations because they indicate cognitive domains whose spatial patterns overlap with regions showing greater BNC in males relative to females. In contrast, we examined the ten most positively correlated Neurosynth terms with the WNC sex difference map, focusing on positively correlations because they indicate cognitive domains whose spatial patterns overlap with regions showing greater WNC in females relative to males.
 

```{r overlapping effects neurosynth decoding of sex differences, fig.height = 7, fig.width = 7}
# identify overlapping significant effects across datasets (2 or more datasets), and get avg RESI for each of those parcels
BNC_sexeffect_overlap <- identify_sexeffect_overlap("BNC") %>% mutate(significant_status = ifelse(signif_2plus == 1, "Sig", "Nonsig"))
WNC_sexeffect_overlap <- identify_sexeffect_overlap("WNC") %>% mutate(significant_status = ifelse(signif_2plus == 1, "Sig", "Nonsig"))

# max number of terms to display per panel (10 = all significant terms in the hypothesized direction)
top_n_terms <- 10

# BNC: FDR across all 125 terms, look at most negative correlations
# (negative = terms aligned with regions showing greater BNC in males; male > female)
BNC_neurosynth <- read.csv(file.path(root, "covariate_analyses", "sex_diff", "output", "all_datasets", "spin_test", "neurosynth", "BNC_neurosynth_spin_test_results_overlap.csv"))
BNC_neurosynth$pvalue.fdr <- p.adjust(BNC_neurosynth$p_spin, method = "fdr")
BNC_neurosynth_fdr <- BNC_neurosynth %>% filter(pvalue.fdr < 0.05)
BNC_neurosynth_top10 <- BNC_neurosynth_fdr %>%
  filter(term.correlation < 0) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = term.correlation, n = top_n_terms)
BNC_neurosynth_top10$term <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", BNC_neurosynth_top10$term))

# WNC: FDR across all 125 terms, look at top positive correlations
# (positive = terms aligned with regions showing greater WNC in females; female > male)
WNC_neurosynth <- read.csv(file.path(root, "covariate_analyses", "sex_diff", "output", "all_datasets", "spin_test", "neurosynth", "WNC_neurosynth_spin_test_results_overlap.csv"))
WNC_neurosynth$pvalue.fdr <- p.adjust(WNC_neurosynth$p_spin, method = "fdr")
WNC_neurosynth_fdr <- WNC_neurosynth %>% filter(pvalue.fdr < 0.05)
WNC_neurosynth_top10 <- WNC_neurosynth_fdr %>%
  filter(term.correlation > 0) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = term.correlation, n = top_n_terms)
WNC_neurosynth_top10$term <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", WNC_neurosynth_top10$term))
WNC_neurosynth_top10$term <- gsub("Autobiographical Memory", "Autobio. Memory", WNC_neurosynth_top10$term)

```

```{r overlap RESI plots}
# plot avg RESI 
BNC_overlap_RESI_plot_lh <- plot_cortex(BNC_sexeffect_overlap, hemi = "left", measure = "mean_resi_sig2", ylim1 = -0.26, ylim2 = 0.1, atlas = "schaefer17_200") 
BNC_overlap_RESI_plot_rh <- plot_cortex(BNC_sexeffect_overlap, hemi = "right", measure = "mean_resi_sig2", ylim1 = -0.26, ylim2 = 0.1, atlas = "schaefer17_200") 
 
WNC_overlap_RESI_plot_lh <- plot_cortex(WNC_sexeffect_overlap, hemi = "left", measure = "mean_resi_sig2", ylim1 = -0.26, ylim2 = 0.3, atlas = "schaefer17_200")

# legend for BNC overlap
ylim1 = -0.26
ylim2 = 0.1
p_BNC <- ggplot() + 
    geom_brain(data = BNC_sexeffect_overlap, atlas = schaefer17_200, 
               mapping=aes(fill=mean_resi_sig2), 
               show.legend=TRUE) +
     scale_fill_gradientn(colours = red_teal_white(256), 
                          values = scales::rescale(c(ylim1, 0, ylim2)), limits = c(ylim1, ylim2), oob = squish, na.value = "white") + 
    theme_void()  +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.box = "horizontal", 
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.9, 'cm'),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.5, 0, -0.5), "cm"))
  
legend_BNC_overlap <- get_legend(p_BNC)

# legend for WNC overlap
ylim1 = -0.26
ylim2 = 0.3
```

```{r supp age by sex int helpers}
# panel order: association -> sensorimotor, using the same network keys
network_order <- c("defaultA", "defaultB", "defaultC",
                   "frontoparietalControlA", "frontoparietalControlB", "frontoparietalControlC",
                   "dorsalAttentionA", "dorsalAttentionB",
                   "salienceVentralAttentionA", "salienceVentralAttentionB",
                   "limbicOrbitofrontal", "limbicTemporopolar", "temporoparietal",
                   "somatomotorA", "somatomotorBAuditory", "visualCentral", "visualPeripheral")

# ---- plotting ----
colorF <- "#C53121"
colorM <- "#0B8CACFF"


traj_legend <- get_legend(
  ggplot(data.frame(age = c(1, 2, 1, 2), fitted = c(1, 2, 1, 2), sex = c("Female", "Female", "Male", "Male")),
         aes(age, fitted, color = sex)) +
```

```{r load age-by-sex interactions}
measures_int <- c(`FC strength` = "FC_strength", `Between-network` = "BNC", `Within-network` = "WNC", `Network pair` = "networkpair")

int_results <- map(measures_int, function(m) {
  read.csv(sprintf("%1$s/all_datasets/GAM/%2$s/all_datasets_GAM_agebysex_interaction_schaefer200x17.csv",
                   output_root, m)) %>%
    mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(GAM.int.pvalue, method = "fdr"),
           significant.fdr = as.integer(p_fdr < 0.05))
})

# expected: FC strength 0/200, between-network 0/200, within-network 22/200, network pair 10/153
imap_dfr(int_results, function(df, label) {
  tibble(Measure = label, n_total = nrow(df), n_sig = sum(df$significant.fdr),
         pct_sig = round(100 * mean(df$significant.fdr), 1))
}) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Age-by-sex interactions in the pooled dataset (Q_FDR < 0.05)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "center", font_size = 20)
```



```{r WNC age-by-sex trajectories, fig.height = 7.9, fig.width = 7.25}
traj_WNC <- read.csv(sprintf("%1$s/all_datasets/GAM/WNC/all_datasets_GAM_agebysex_fitted_schaefer200x17.csv", output_root)) %>%
  rename(age = smooth_var) %>%
  mutate(region = add_17(region),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")))

WNC_int_regions <- int_results$`Within-network` %>%
  mutate(region = add_17(region)) %>%
  filter(significant.fdr == 1) %>%
  mutate(network = factor(sapply(strsplit(region, "_"), `[`, 3), levels = network_order_17)) %>%
  arrange(network, region) %>%
  pull(region)

traj_WNC_sig <- traj_WNC %>% filter(region %in% WNC_int_regions)
y_lim_WNC <- range(traj_WNC_sig$fitted)

WNC_traj_plots <- lapply(WNC_int_regions, function(r) plot_traj(r, traj_WNC_sig, pretty_region(r), y_lim_WNC))

WNC_traj_final     <- assemble_traj(WNC_traj_plots, ncol = 5, y_label = "Within-Network Connectivity")

WNC_traj_final
```

# Fig. S5. The principal gradient of functional connectivity in females and males. 
```{r PC1 mean in males and females, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 6.7}

datasets <- c("PNC", "NKI", "HCPD", "HBN", "all_datasets")

# ---- load mean PC1 loadings by sex ----
pc1_brain <- map_dfr(datasets, function(dataset) {
  gd_dir <- sprintf("%s/output/%s/gradient_dispersion", proj_root, dataset)
  if (dataset == "all_datasets") {
    df <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/pc1_loadings_long_%s.csv", gd_dir, dataset)) %>%
      group_by(sex, parcel, parcel_label, hemisphere, network) %>%
      summarise(pc1_mean = mean(pc1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    df <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/pc1_parcel_by_sex_%s.csv", gd_dir, dataset))
  }
  df %>%
    rename(region = parcel_label) %>%
    mutate(region = if_else(startsWith(region, "17"), region, paste0("17", region)),
           dataset = dataset)
})

# shared color limits across datasets and sexes  
pc1_lims <- quantile(pc1_brain$pc1_mean, c(0, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

pc1_fill <- paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_c("grDevices::Blue-Yellow",
                                              limits = pc1_lims, oob = squish, na.value = "white")


pc1_brain_PNC    <- plot_pc1_dataset("PNC", "PNC")
pc1_brain_NKI    <- plot_pc1_dataset("NKI", "NKI")
pc1_brain_HCPD   <- plot_pc1_dataset("HCPD", "HCP-D")
pc1_brain_HBN    <- plot_pc1_dataset("HBN", "HBN")
pc1_brain_pooled <- plot_pc1_dataset("all_datasets", "Pooled Dataset", horizontal = TRUE)

# ---- shared legend, labeled by hierarchy ----
pc1_legend <- get_legend(
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, pc1 = 0), aes(x, y, fill = pc1)) +
    geom_tile() +
            paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_c("grDevices::Blue-Yellow",
                                      limits = pc1_lims, oob = squish,
                                      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5),
                                      guide = guide_colorbar(title = "Mean PC1 loading", title.position = "top",
                                                             title.hjust = 0.5)) + 
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(3, "cm"))
)

# ---- assemble (layout matches Figs. 5 and 7: PNC/HCP-D top, NKI/HBN middle) ----
row1 <- plot_grid(pc1_brain_PNC, NULL, pc1_brain_HCPD, ncol = 3, rel_widths = c(1, 0.05, 1))
row2 <- plot_grid(pc1_brain_NKI, NULL, pc1_brain_HBN, ncol = 3, rel_widths = c(1, 0.05, 1))

pc1_brain_figure <- plot_grid(row1, row2, pc1_brain_pooled, NULL, pc1_legend, NULL,
                              ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1, 0.6, 0.1, 0.25, 0.1))
pc1_brain_figure
```
